properties.evidence: THE SAME FINDING, RE-DERIVED THREE DAYS LATER BY A SESSION THAT DID NOT SEARCH FIRST. The 2026-08-26 node already says it: the orphan check short-circuits on degree > 0 before it looks at pointer properties, so a fact attached to anything hides its broken subject, and the better a fact is linked the less likely its dangling subject is to be seen. The 08-29 node states the same mechanism in its own words and calls it new. LINKED RATHER THAN MERGED because both reasons matter and the numbers genuinely differ: 08-26 measured 8 of 9 caught with 1 invisible, 08-29 measured 7 of 9 with 2. Neither is wrong - fact:defect-kit-manifest-drift-is-invisible-to-ci gained edges between those dates and crossed from visible to invisible, which is the mechanism demonstrating itself on a live node. The later node also carries what the earlier does not: the bias argument, and the rule that shipped as #373.
